title: Reinforced Internal-External Knowledge Synergistic Reasoning for Efficient Adaptive Search Agent
authors: Ziyang Huang; Xiaowei Yuan; Yiming Ju; Jun Zhao; Kang Liu
why_relevant: IKEA uses RL with a knowledge-boundary aware reward to decide when to retrieve vs rely on parametric knowledge, directly addressing adaptive retrieval control and avoiding noisy retrieval/knowledge conflict.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is efficiency-oriented adaptive retrieval rather than explicit robustness evaluation under adversarial or noisy evidence.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: When to Retrieve
